mapper.insert: INSERT INTO third_party_crawl_log( merchant_user_id, source_name, source_url, source_product_id, task_name, status, request_url, response_code, response_body, error_message, cost_ms, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{merchantUserId}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceProductId}, #{taskName}, #{status}, #{requestUrl}, #{responseCode}, #{responseBody}, #{errorMessage}, #{costMs}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM third_party_crawl_log WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_user_id = #{merchantUserId}
